messages:
Erin (People Ops): quick note  we've updated the Performance Review & Calibration section in the handbook — new timeline + calibration panel guidance. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/perf-cycle (summary below)
Erin (People Ops): tl;dr: review window moved 2 weeks earlier, managers must schedule calibration slots, and managers participating in calibration must complete a 20-min "Fair Calibration" microcourse.
Noah (Comp & Ben): small heads-up: comp will lock salary change requests 48h after calibration concludes, so please surface any exceptions early.
Vik (Engineering): will the earlier window affect release blockers for teams with late feature freezes?
Erin (People Ops): we added an exceptions flow  if your team has an approved freeze, file a ticket to people-ops with tag "perf-exception" and include expected freeze end date. People Ops will confirm and mark the team as deferred.
Zara (People Ops): action: managers — add 2x 30-min calibration slots to the shared calendar by EOD Wednesday: https://sheets.redwood.ai/calibration-slots (sheet: team, slot1, slot2, timezone). Reply here with "SLOTS SET" when done.
Vik (Engineering): SLOTS SET  added eng-infra slots and timezone.
Noah (Comp & Ben): also note: new calibration rubric attached in the handbook  please use it for rating rationale and short written notes for >1 level changes. Helps auditability.
lms-bot: Assigned course: "Fair Calibration for Managers" to 142 users (managers & calibration participants). Due in 14 days. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/fair-calibration
Erin (People Ops): tracking: we'll run weekly completion reports and flag non-compliant participants to their manager. Managers, ensure your backups (acting managers) are listed in the HRIS to receive assignments.
Noah (Comp & Ben): I'll schedule a brief Q&A session (30m) next Tuesday for any comp-related questions post-calibration. Invite will go to managers+people-ops.
Vik (Engineering): small question re: calibration notes retention  how long are we storing comments?
Zara (People Ops): retention follows our standard review records policy: 2 years. If you need longer for audit, ping compliance.
Erin (People Ops): thanks all  please complete the microcourse and set slots ASAP. We'll post a short FAQ in #docs and share the calibration rubric slide deck. :white_check_mark:
